links.outcome: Draft utilization and time savings by role and specialty
links.effect: Overall draft utilization 38%; clinicians 43% vs scheduling staff 33%. Time saved 23 seconds for support staff vs 3 seconds for clinicians; variability across specialties.
links.quote: However, the effectiveness of artificial intelligence (AI)-generated draft responses varies by clinical role and specialty, indicating the need for tailored implementations.

unlisted_practices: Measuring draft utilization rate and message response time as pilot outcomes of LLM-drafted patient message replies across roles and specialties

screen.reason: Evaluates a real-world clinical deployment of an LLM tool in Epic EHR for drafting patient portal message replies, measuring utilization and impact on response times.
